question: Which of the following banks was placed under moratorium for a period of one month by the Reserve Bank of India in November 2020?

options.text: North Kanara Gaud Saraswat Co-operative Bank Ltd

solution:
The correct answer is **__Lakshmi Vilas Bank Ltd.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshmi Vilas Bank** Ltd was placed under moratorium for a period of one month by the Reserve Bank of India in November 2020.

 
• The RBI appointed the Committee of Directors (CoD) composed of three independent directors Meeta Makhan, Shakti Sinha, and Satish Kumar Kalra.
 
• The committee will be headed by Meeta Makhan.
 
• After shareholders ousted seven directors of the board, the Reserve Bank of India has approved the appointment of a three-member Committee of Directors (CoD) to run the daily affairs of debt-ridden Lakshmi Vilas Bank (LVB).
 
• This CoD will exercise the discretionary powers of MD & CEO in the ad-interim.
